page_title: KOL 0-0 FRE | FC Koln v Freiburg 04/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+3' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Michael Gregoritsch trots off the pitch and is replaced by Junior Adamu (Freiburg).
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vincenzo Grifo departs the field of play to be replaced by Florent Muslija (Freiburg).

86' Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
84' Timo Schultz prepares a substitution. Luca Waldschmidt is replaced by Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln).
84' Faride Alidou will be replaced by Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln).
83' A pass into the box finds Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Noah Atubolu denies him.

82' Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
78' Christian Streich has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) replacing Christian Gunter.
78' Substitution. Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg) on for Roland Sallai.
78' The attendance for today's match is 50000.
77' Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) powers a header just wide of the right post following a cross into the middle of the box.
74' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Soren Storks ignores the protests.
72' A pass into the box finds Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Noah Atubolu denies him.
72' FC Koln failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
67' The game has come to an end for Linton Maina. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln).

67' Good chance! Lucas Holer (Freiburg) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
67' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
65' FC Koln can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
63' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the roof of the net, but Noah Atubolu is prepared and leaps to thwart him.
60' Dangerous play by Dominique Heintz (1. FC Koln). Soren Storks blows his whistle for a foul.
57' Timo Schultz has decided to substitute Jeff Chabot and he is replaced by Dominique Heintz (1. FC Koln).
57' Substitution. Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jan Thielmann walks off.
56' FC Koln have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
54' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
53' The corner from Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) is hurriedly cleared.
51' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Soren Storks didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
50' Soren Storks blows his whistle and signals a foul after Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) brought his opponent down.
48' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Soren Storks blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
44' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. A free kick has been awarded to Freiburg.

43' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Noah Atubolu makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
38' Soren Storks blows the whistle, Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) is penalised for a foul.
37' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
34' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) trips an opposition player and Soren Storks signals a foul.
30' Great teamplay by FC Koln as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
25' The shots on goal statistics – 1:0.

22' What a chance that is! Roland Sallai (Freiburg) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
20' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg), whose header flies narrowly wide of the left post.

18' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Noah Atubolu shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
18' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

17' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. FC Koln win a corner kick.
14' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

14' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Freiburg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
12' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
8' The resulting corner from Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
7' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. FC Koln can continue in their attacking effort.
3' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
3' FC Koln couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
2' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Soren Storks blows for a foul. It's a free kick to FC Koln in a dangerous position.
